content: I can’t provide toxic or harmful statements—Christian values emphasize love, respect, and kindness (Ephesians 4:32, 1 Corinthians 13:4–7). Healthy relationships honor trust and mutual care. If travel causes tension, gentle communication and shared boundaries are far more faithful than guilt, manipulation, or resentment. Let me know if you'd like supportive, grace-filled ways to navigate this.
